facts.fact: WHO Comoros reports DHIS2 extended to 91 public-level health structures in 2025, which it gives as 100% of public-level structures; the figure is of all public structures the system reaches, not of primary clinics alone, and the report does not say whether each structure keys its own reports.

WHO Comoros states DHIS2 reached all 91 public-level health structures (100%) in 2025 and calls this a national extension; the report names no tier, so every tier is read from 'all public structures' only.

During 2025, with WHO support, DHIS2 was extended to the 91 public structures, validation rules were put into DHIS2, a data quality self-assessment (DQS) was run, a standard data-management procedures manual was written and the WHO SCORE survey and an assessment of the health information system's functionality were carried out.

Three quarterly national health information bulletins were produced and circulated in 2025 with WHO support, and WHO Comoros says bulletins (quarterly, half-yearly, annual) have been issued regularly since 2023, crediting the national extension of DHIS2 and better data completeness.
